title: Shinonome Akito — The View From Up Above〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: New York Academy of Music

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whew. Let's stop here for now!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's nice that we get to do morning practices over here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. This wouldn't have been possible if we weren't allowed to stay in the dorms. And I'm glad we thought to ask Mr. Lloyd about places where we can practice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. The day just doesn't feel right without it.
<Hey, you guys!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? That sounded like Len...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The coast looks clear. Come on out.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hi, everyone!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Good morning.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Morning, Miku! It's nice to see you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Nice to see you too. We came over to see what you were all up to today.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Today? We're actually pretty free...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Really? We figured that you'd have to move over to the hotel soon.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's the thing. We still haven't been able to find another hotel with free rooms.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So we're going to spend today sightseeing near the Academy, I think.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, that's a great idea! And it sounds really fun!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Do you already have some destinations in mind?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, one of the students we did that session with yesterday told us about everyone's favorite hangouts.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There's apparently a popular boutique shop and supermarket nearby, so we're thinking about going to those places first.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, cool! That sounds really exciting!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm also really excited, since American supermarkets are supposed to be really spacious and have a huge selection of goods.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Same! Do you think they'll have any souvenirs that my mom would like?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're already thinking about souvenirs? Aren't you getting a little ahead of yourself?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, I'm not!
If I don't start looking now, then I'm not gonna be able to decide later when we leave.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, even just yesterday, quite a few things caught my attention.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Exactly! I bet your family's looking forward to seeing what you bring back, Akito. Especially Ena.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: My mom said she wants some tea, and Ena asked for chocolates...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
My mom also asked for tea.
And tea snacks.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, tea sounds like a popular option.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I wonder what I should get.
My parents said they didn't have any preferences.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Same here.
Hmm... Should I get snacks, or something more commemorative...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, there's gotta be tons of things over here that you can't get in Japan!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Ena said she wanted a certain assortment of chocolates or whatever...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Seriously, that's complicated enough in Japanese... Did she not realize how hard it's gonna be for me to ask about that in English?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Nothing. But, here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A leather passport case...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I chose it with Airi's help today.
Call it a parting gift from me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I should get her something in return.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me! Apparently, the reusable bags they sell at supermarkets make for really great souvenirs!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. Some of the more famous supermarkets sell reusable bags with cute and cool designs.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'd like to spend some time looking at those when we go.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Depending on the design, Mom and Ena might really like that.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'll give it some more thought if they have anything they might like.)
